scope: Exercise exact password bytes through both the password-change API and subsequent sign-in, without changing production authentication policy or claiming full requirement verification.

V6.2.1.observation: The existing 12-character policy exceeds the ASVS v5.0.0 Level 1 mandatory minimum of 8; the standard strongly recommends 15. Existing schema boundary tests cover 11/12 and 256/257. Manual review must cover every account creation/replacement path and disposition the recommendation.

V6.2.5.observation: The shared password schema accepts lower/uppercase, numeric-only, punctuation-only, leading/trailing whitespace and Unicode examples without composition rules. Representative behavioral coverage is not exhaustive input coverage or manual review.

V6.2.8.observation: Real password-change and sign-in APIs accept exact composed Unicode current/new passwords; password change rejects an NFD current-password variant, and later sign-in rejects case, trailing-space, NFD and previous-password variants. All remaining credential paths and the wider requirement still need manual review.

policy.current: 12-character minimum; maximum 256; scrypt hashes the submitted password.
policy.strongRecommendation: ASVS Level 1 strongly recommends a 15-character minimum; it is not silently adopted or waived.

finalSource.method: Sorted unique git ls-files -co --exclude-standard -z -- packages tools plugin; hash path+NUL+bytes+NUL.

actualBundledJourneys.scope: Final shipped kernel drives the complete starter scaffold, loan feature and brownfield CLI/library repair fixture. Node22/24 binaries were not available, so this source version is not claimed as validated on those runtimes.

inventoryState.QLT02: Unmapped and unqualified; no structural, semantic or qualification status changed.

privacyScan.scope: All added tracked and untracked lines against HEAD, scanned without staging or changing the user's index.
privacyScan.disposition: Both findings are literal [redacted] expected-output markers in the synthetic logging redaction test (logging.test.ts:30-31); they are not credentials. The scanner's assignment heuristic flags these deliberate redaction assertions.

limits: Representative tests do not establish full ASVS requirements, independent security review, password-manager behavior, host or deployment assurance, or product policy approval. Node22 and Node24 validation is historical for recipe 0.4.4 and is not attributed to this source version.
actionsNotTaken: No auth/identity/exposure policy change, 15-character policy adoption, common-password corpus/dependency, ASVS pass or waiver, QLT-02 mapping, requirement qualification, migration prototype code in the repository, schema activation, commit, push or new branch/worktree.
